name: Dew web
description: An orb web in a meadow at dawn, the low sun behind it: each sector of the web is a part of the spectrum (the bass at the bottom, the high notes at the top) and its threads shiver with it; hundreds of dew drops along the spiral each hold the meadow upside down and the sun focused to a point that brightens with the high notes; the silk shines with colours along it with the middle notes, and the spider waits at the hub.
